Definition: to flow freely (as water), i.e. (specifically) to have a (sexual) flux; figuratively, to waste away; also to overflow
BiblicalUsage: 1) to flow, gush, issue, discharge; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to flow, gush; 1a2) to die, pine away (fig.); 1a3) to flow (of issue from woman), have an issue, flux; 1a4) flowing (participle)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
